hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); f="${f#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/}"; case "$f" in man/*|docs/*|NAMESPACE) echo "$f is generated or off limits: edit roxygen comments in R/ and run devtools::document(); never edit docs/." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.R|*.r) Rscript --vanilla -e 'invisible(parse(file = commandArgs(TRUE)[1], keep.source = FALSE))' "$f" 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; esac
